task.title: To mark a clause for deletion

context.p: When you delete a clause from an agreement, the entire clause is removed from the text of the document.

step.cmd: Click the icon to delete the selected clause.

stepresult.p: A dialog is displayed in the X-Author pane asking you to confirm the deletion.

step.cmd:
Click Yes to mark the clause for deletion. The clause is marked with a strikethrough in the document and the Document pane. You can click the
Undo icon to remove the mark at any time in the same session.
Check-in the document and choose Reconcile.

result.p: The clause is removed from the document and a "Deleted" entry is recorded in the Agreement Clause related list on the agreement record in Salesforce.
